_comment: Objective-neutral oracle inventory for libxml2 v2.15.3.
The published surface is under include/libxml/. impl_files mirrors the
LIBXML2_SRCS link unit observed in the configured build plus its private headers.
_comment_files: `api_headers` is the published surface: 45 headers, 1416 XMLPUBFUN
libxml2 keeps its sources flat at the repo root beside tests and programs,
so the compiled library sources are enumerated instead of naming `.`.
_comment_out_of_scope: `paths` is empty: impl_files enumerates only the library link unit and
api_headers names include/libxml/, so tests, programs, fuzzers and Python
bindings are outside the inventory by construction.
`features` is documentation only - no composer reads it. It lists the
LIBXML2_WITH_* options disabled by build.json's configure command.
